text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru doesn't show up for training, so I go and look for her…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The omen to beware of lightning… again?! But why? It's so sunny outside…
choice_data_list: You're busy with divining, I see…
You're busy with divining, I see…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Upon closer inspection… Th-those clouds look kind of menacing, right?
choice_data_list: Aren't you forgetting something? Starts with a t, ends with a raining…
Aren't you forgetting something? Starts with a t, ends with a raining…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give her a storm of a scolding so this doesn't happen again.
